# 1. Data

Curated dataset for host plant associations for Danainae butterflies including information for ATPa resistance form & cardenolide content.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
library(ggnewscale)
library(grid)
```

```{r}
plant_butterfly_long_all = read.csv("./plant_butterfly_long_all.csv")
```

# 2. Phylogenies

```{r}
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(stringr)
```

## 2.1 Danaini

Phylogenetic tree for Danaiini butterflies prepared in this study

```{r}
# Read species-level Danaini tree
butterfly.tree = read.tree("./2_Danaini_phylo_tree/Danaini_concat.treefile")

# Write a clean copy
write.tree(butterfly.tree, file = "Danaini_species_tree.newick")

tr_new = read.tree("Danaini_species_tree.newick")


# Outgroups (match tip-label formatting)
outgroups = c("Tellervo zoilus", "Mechanitis polymnia") %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") # replaces whitespace with underscores

# 1) Host species (spaces -> underscores)
host_species_u = plant_butterfly_long_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(butterfly_species), str_trim(butterfly_species) != "") %>%
  pull(butterfly_species) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique() %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") # replaces whitespace with underscores

# 2) Tree tips
tree_tips = str_trim(tr_new$tip.label)

# 3) Prune to (host Danaini + outgroups) 
tips_keep = unique(c(intersect(tree_tips, host_species_u), outgroups))
tr_keep = ape::keep.tip(tr_new, tips_keep)

# 4) Root on outgroups (explicit)
tr_rooted = ape::root(tr_keep, outgroup = outgroups, resolve.root = TRUE)

# Plot
ggtree(tr_rooted, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 2) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = !isTip, label = node), size = 4, color = "purple")
```

Check which species are only present in tree or host plant data

```{r}
# Tips that were in the original tree but NOT kept (i.e., dropped by pruning)
dropped_from_tree = setdiff(tree_tips, tips_keep)

# Host species that are NOT found in the tree (i.e., records in data with no matching tip)
hosts_not_in_tree = setdiff(host_species_u, tree_tips)
```

Rotate internal nodes for visual clarity; topology and branch lengths are unchanged.

```{r}
tr_rooted
tr1 = rotateNodes(tr_rooted, nodes = 96)
tr2 = rotateNodes(tr1, nodes = 88)
tr3 = rotateNodes(tr2, nodes = 94)
tr4 = rotateNodes(tr3, nodes = 100)
tr5 = rotateNodes(tr4, nodes = 67)
tr6 = rotateNodes(tr5, nodes = 63)
tr7 = rotateNodes(tr6, nodes = 64)
tr8 = rotateNodes(tr7, nodes = 57)
tr9 = rotateNodes(tr8, nodes = 95)
tr10 = rotateNodes(tr9, nodes = 96)



ggtree(tr10, ladderize = FALSE) +
  geom_tiplab(size=2) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), size=4, color="purple")


#save Danaini tree
write.tree(tr10,"./danaini_species_final_tree.newick")
```

## 2.2 Apocynaceae

Use time-calibrated phylogenetic tree of Apocynaceae published in [Fishbein et al. (2018)](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/ecology-and-evolution/articles/10.3389/fevo.2021.719741/full#B32). The phylogeny covers all major lineages in the family and includes 1,041 species (ca. 20% of species richness) and 50% of the genera (ca. 180 out of 378 currently accepted sensu [Endress et al., 2018-2019](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/ecology-and-evolution/articles/10.3389/fevo.2021.719741/full#B28)).

Turn species-level phylogeny to genus-level phylogeny:

<https://blog.phytools.org/2014/11/pruning-trees-to-one-member-per-genus.html>.

Extract genus names from tip labels → 2) pick one tip index per genus → 3) `drop.tip()` everything else → 4) rename tips to genus.

```{r}

plant.tree = read.tree("./Apo_Mora_phylo_tree//1041_Fishbein et al. 2018[outgroups_removed].newick")

# extract genus
genus = sapply(strsplit(plant.tree$tip.label, "_"), `[`, 1)

# find one tip per genus (first occurrence)
keep = unique(genus)

# indices of tips to keep
i = sapply(keep, function(x) which(genus == x)[1])

# prune everything else
plant.tree.genus = drop.tip(plant.tree, plant.tree$tip.label[-i])

# rename tips to genus
plant.tree.genus$tip.label = keep

plot(plant.tree.genus, cex = 0.6)
```

Keep in the Apocynaceae phylogeny only genera present in the Danaini-host plant matrix.

Check how many plant genera present in Ackery 1988 butterfly-plant matrix (only Apocynaceae) are also present in the phylogeny. Six genera are missing from the tree.

```{r}
# 1) genera in plant_butterfly_long_all
plant.butterfly.mat = plant_butterfly_long_all %>% 
  filter(plant_family == "Apocynaceae") %>%
  pull(plant_genus) %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# 2) genera ingenus-pruned tree
plant.genera.tree = plant.tree.genus$tip.label %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# 3) compare
missing_in_tree = setdiff(plant.butterfly.mat, plant.genera.tree)
extra_in_tree   = setdiff(plant.genera.tree, plant.butterfly.mat)


cat("Missing in tree:", length(missing_in_tree), "\n")

missing_in_tree
```

Six Apocynaceae genera present in historical host records were not sampled in the Fishbein et al. (2018) phylogeny and were excluded from phylogeny.

```{r}
# 2) Remove genera that still aren't in the phylogeny
drop_genera = c("Graphistemma", "Ibatia", "Ischnostemma", "Leichardtia", "Morrenia", "Raphistemma")

plant_butterfly_apoc = plant_butterfly_long_all %>%
  filter(plant_family == "Apocynaceae") %>%
  filter(!(plant_genus %in% drop_genera))

intersect(drop_genera, unique(plant_butterfly_apoc$plant_genus))
```

```{r}
# 3) Prune the genus tree to match the remaining genera
genera_keep = sort(unique(plant_butterfly_apoc$plant_genus))

plant.tree.genus.pruned = drop.tip(
  plant.tree.genus,
  setdiff(plant.tree.genus$tip.label, genera_keep)
) %>%
  ladderize()

# Rotate tree nodes 
#plant.tree.genus.pruned_rot = rotateNodes(plant.tree.genus.pruned,"all")

tree.plot = ggtree(plant.tree.genus.pruned, branch.length = "none",ladderize = FALSE) +
  #xlim(0, 90) + 
  geom_tiplab(size = 1.5, offset=0.2) +
  geom_label2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), size=2, color="darkred", alpha=0.5)
  
tree.plot

#ggsave("./apocynaceae_tree.pdf", tree.plot)

write.tree(plant.tree.genus.pruned,"./apocynaceae_genus_final_tree.newick")
```

## 2.3 Moraceae

-   Recoding plant genera names for Moraceae based on their current synonyms (<https://powo.science.kew.org/>). There are four Moraceae genera in Ackery 1988: Cephalotrophis, Ficus, Malaisia, Streblus, Urostigma.

    (1) Cephalotrophis is a host plant for *Euploea tulliolus*. It's a synonym to *Trophis scandens* (synonym of *Malaisia scandens*). There are reported independent records of *Euploea tulliolus* for *Trophis scandens* <https://era.dpi.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/9230/1/2010Euploea_tulliolus_AE_37_4.pdf>

    (2) Malaisia is a synonym to *Trophis scandens.* <https://era.dpi.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/9230/1/2010Euploea_tulliolus_AE_37_4.pdf>

    (3) Urostigma is a subgenus of Ficus. <https://powo.science.kew.org/results?q=Urostigma>

The moraceae tree should include the genera Trophis, Streblus and Ficus. There are two lineages of Trophis. We take the one of Trophis scandens

Use genus-level moraceae tree from timetree: <https://timetree.org/>. Trophis-1 corresponds to Trophis scandens

```{r}

plant.tree.moraceae = read.tree("./Apo_Mora_phylo_tree/moraceae_genus.nwk")

# 1) Rename Trophis-1 to Trophis
plant.tree.moraceae$tip.label

plant.tree.moraceae$tip.label[
  plant.tree.moraceae$tip.label == "Trophis-1"
] = "Trophis"

plot(plant.tree.moraceae, cex = 0.6)
```

Keep in the Moraceae phylogeny only genera present in the Danaini-host plant matrix.

Check how many plant genera present in Ackery 1988 butterfly-plant matrix (only Apocynaceae) are also present in the phylogeny. Six genera are missing from the tree.

```{r}
# 1) genera in plant_butterfly_long_all
plant.butterfly.mat.mora = plant_butterfly_long_all %>% 
  filter(plant_family == "Moraceae") %>%
  pull(plant_genus) %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# 2) genera ingenus-pruned tree
plant.genera.tree.mora = plant.tree.moraceae$tip.label %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# 3) compare
missing_in_tree.mora = setdiff(plant.butterfly.mat.mora, plant.genera.tree.mora)
extra_in_tree.mora   = setdiff(plant.genera.tree.mora, plant.butterfly.mat.mora)


cat("Missing in tree:", length(missing_in_tree.mora), "\n")

missing_in_tree.mora
```

```{r}
# 4) Prune tree
plant.tree.moraceae.pruned = keep.tip(plant.tree.moraceae, plant.butterfly.mat.mora) %>%
  ladderize()

tree.plot.mora.pruned = ggtree(plant.tree.moraceae.pruned, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, offset = 0)

tree.plot.mora.pruned

write.tree(plant.tree.moraceae.pruned, "./moraceae_genus_final_tree.newick")
```

## 2.4 Graft Apocynacae & Moraceae

```{r}
# read both trees
apoc = read.tree("./apocynaceae_genus_final_tree.newick")
mora = read.tree("./moraceae_genus_final_tree.newick")

# backbone with two placeholder tips
backbone = read.tree(text = "(Apoc_placeholder:1,Mora_placeholder:1);")

# graft Apocynaceae onto Apoc_placeholder
t1 = bind.tree(backbone, apoc, where = which(backbone$tip.label == "Apoc_placeholder"))
t1 = drop.tip(t1, "Apoc_placeholder")

# graft Moraceae onto Mora_placeholder (note tip labels changed after first drop)
t2 = bind.tree(t1, mora, where = which(t1$tip.label == "Mora_placeholder"))
plant.tree.apoc_mora = drop.tip(t2, "Mora_placeholder")

ggtree(plant.tree.apoc_mora, branch.length = "none",ladderize = FALSE) +
  #xlim(0, 90) + 
  geom_tiplab(size = 1.5, offset=0.2)

write.tree(plant.tree.apoc_mora, "./apocynacear_moraceae__genus_final_tree.newick")
```

# 3. Danaini species x plant genera heatmap

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Danaini species × plant genera
# - Cell value: host use presence (0/1) for each butterfly species × plant genus
# - Row order: Danaini species phylogeny (danaini_species_final_tree.newick)
# - Column order: plant phylogeny (Apocynaceae + Moraceae graft)
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1) Data prep: Apocynaceae & Moraceae, presence/absence
# ============================================================

# Keep only Apocynaceae & Moraceae
plant_butterfly_apoc.morac = plant_butterfly_long_all %>%
  filter(plant_family %in% c("Apocynaceae", "Moraceae"))

# Remove genera that still aren't in the phylogeny
drop_genera = c("Graphistemma", "Ibatia", "Ischnostemma", "Leichardtia", "Morrenia", "Raphistemma")
plant_butterfly_apoc.morac = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac %>%
  filter(!(plant_genus %in% drop_genera))


# -----------------------------
# Function to replace missing/empty taxonomy labels with "unplaced"
# -----------------------------
clean_tax <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- "unplaced"
  x
}


# Standardize species/genus strings (important for matching tree tips)
plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac %>%
  mutate(
    butterfly_species = clean_tax(butterfly_species),
    plant_genus       = clean_tax(plant_genus),
    # standardize spaces -> underscores to match IQ-TREE style tip labels
    butterfly_species = stringr::str_replace_all(butterfly_species, "\\s+", "_")
  )

# ============================================================
# 2) Species × plant-genus long table (presence 0/1)
#    - Keep unique butterfly_species × plant_genus pairs
#    - Fill all missing pairs with present = 0
# ============================================================

# Unique species present in dataset (optionally restrict later to those in the tree)
butterfly_species = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  distinct(butterfly_species) %>%
  pull(butterfly_species) %>%
  sort()

# Unique plant genera indataset (already filtered to those sampled in phylogeny)
plant_genera = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  distinct(plant_genus) %>%
  pull(plant_genus) %>%
  sort()

# Observed host-use (present==1) at species level
species_plant_use = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  filter(present == 1) %>%
  distinct(butterfly_species, plant_genus) %>%
  mutate(present = 1L)

# Complete all combinations and fill absent with 0
butterfly_plant_matrix_long = tidyr::crossing(
  butterfly_species = butterfly_species,
  plant_genus       = plant_genera
) %>%
  left_join(species_plant_use, by = c("butterfly_species", "plant_genus")) %>%
  mutate(present = replace_na(present, 0L))


# ============================================================
# 3) Plant genus metadata (for tip points / strips)
# ============================================================

col_tax = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  distinct(plant_genus, plant_subfamily, plant_tribe, plant_subtribe, known_cardenolide) %>%
  mutate(
    plant_genus       = clean_tax(plant_genus),
    plant_subfamily   = clean_tax(plant_subfamily),
    plant_tribe       = clean_tax(plant_tribe),
    plant_subtribe    = clean_tax(plant_subtribe),
    known_cardenolide = replace_na(as.integer(known_cardenolide), 0L)
  ) %>%
  distinct(plant_genus, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("plant_genus")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4) Build matrix (+ optional column metadata for later top bars)
# ============================================================

clean_tax <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- "unplaced"
  x
}

# --- species × plant genus (presence/absence) ---
plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac %>%
  mutate(
    butterfly_species = clean_tax(butterfly_species),
    plant_genus       = clean_tax(plant_genus),
    # match tree tip format
    butterfly_species = stringr::str_replace_all(butterfly_species, "\\s+", "_")
  )

# keep one unique record per butterfly species – plant genus pair
# (present should already be 0/1; if any duplicates exist, take max)
butterfly_plant_matrix_long = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  group_by(butterfly_species, plant_genus) %>%
  summarise(present = max(as.integer(present), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# keep plant genera metadata (unchanged conceptually)
col_tax = plant_butterfly_apoc.morac2 %>%
  distinct(plant_genus, plant_subfamily, plant_tribe, plant_subtribe, known_cardenolide) %>%
  mutate(
    plant_genus       = clean_tax(plant_genus),
    plant_subfamily   = clean_tax(plant_subfamily),
    plant_tribe       = clean_tax(plant_tribe),
    plant_subtribe    = clean_tax(plant_subtribe),
    known_cardenolide = replace_na(as.integer(known_cardenolide), 0L)
  ) %>%
  distinct(plant_genus, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("plant_genus")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5) Align to phylogenies via factor levels (robust, no NA)
#    - derive plotting order from the *drawn* ggtree tip order
#    - then enforce that order by factoring butterfly_species + plant_genus
# ============================================================

to_tip = function(x){
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
}

Danaini.tree = ape::read.tree("./danaini_species_final_tree.newick")
Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree = ape::read.tree("./apocynacear_moraceae__genus_final_tree.newick")

# make tree tip labels consistent with matrix (underscores)
Danaini.tree$tip.label = to_tip(Danaini.tree$tip.label)
Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree$tip.label = to_tip(Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree$tip.label)

# ---- PLANT order: tips as DRAWN in ggtree ----
col_order = ggtree::ggtree(Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree, ladderize = FALSE)$data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(y) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label) %>%
  to_tip()



# ---- BUTTERFLY order: tips as DRAWN in ggtree ----
# make matrix names consistent too (belt + suspenders)
butterfly_plant_matrix_long = butterfly_plant_matrix_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    butterfly_species = to_tip(butterfly_species),
    plant_genus       = to_tip(plant_genus)
  )

# plotting order from ggtree "drawn" y positions
row_order = ggtree::ggtree(Danaini.tree, ladderize = FALSE)$data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(y) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label) %>%
  to_tip()

# ---- identify taxa present in matrix but missing from trees ----
missing_butterflies = setdiff(unique(butterfly_plant_matrix_long$butterfly_species),
                              Danaini.tree$tip.label)

missing_plants = setdiff(unique(butterfly_plant_matrix_long$plant_genus),
                         Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree$tip.label)

# ---- drop unmatched rows BEFORE factoring ----
butterfly_plant_matrix_long_plot = butterfly_plant_matrix_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    butterfly_species %in% Danaini.tree$tip.label,
    plant_genus       %in% Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree$tip.label
  )

# ---- restrict orders to taxa actually present in plot df ----
row_order = row_order[row_order %in% butterfly_plant_matrix_long_plot$butterfly_species]
col_order = col_order[col_order %in% butterfly_plant_matrix_long_plot$plant_genus]

# ---- enforce phylogenetic order by factoring ----
butterfly_plant_matrix_long2 = butterfly_plant_matrix_long_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    butterfly_species = factor(butterfly_species, levels = row_order),
    plant_genus       = factor(plant_genus,       levels = col_order)
  )

# ---- align plant metadata to the same plotting order ----
col_tax2 = col_tax %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("plant_genus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(plant_genus = to_tip(plant_genus)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(plant_genus %in% col_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(plant_genus = factor(plant_genus, levels = col_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(plant_genus)
```

# 4. Danaini, plant trees & heatmap

Use geom_tile for the heatmap: <https://r-graph-gallery.com/79-levelplot-with-ggplot2.html>

## 4.1 Heatmap (species × plant genera; present 0/1; Asclepias purple)

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1) Butterfly × plant genera heatmap (presence/absence)
# ============================================================

df_tile = butterfly_plant_matrix_long2 %>%
  mutate(
    present = as.integer(present),
    tile_state = dplyr::case_when(
      plant_genus == "Asclepias" & present == 1L ~ "Asclepias",
      present == 1L                               ~ "Present",
      TRUE                                       ~ "Absent"
    ),
    tile_state = factor(tile_state, levels = c("Absent", "Present", "Asclepias"))
  )

p_tile = ggplot(df_tile, aes(x = plant_genus, y = butterfly_species, fill = tile_state)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Absent" = "white",
    "Present" = "black",
    "Asclepias" = "#885ca6"
  ),
  breaks = c("Absent", "Present", "Asclepias"),
  labels = c(
    "Absent",
    "Present",
    expression(italic(Asclepias))
  ),
  drop = FALSE
) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = col_order, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = row_order, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Host use") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
#    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p_tile
```

## 4.2 Danaini tree

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2) Danaini tree + ATPα state STRIP (clean, publication-style)
#   - ATPα shown as a thin strip between tree and tip labels
#   - no tile borders
#   - robust tip-name matching
# ============================================================

# ---- helpers ----
to_tip = function(x){
  x %>% as.character() %>% str_trim() %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
}

abbr_tip = function(x){
  x = to_tip(x) %>% str_replace_all("_", " ")
  vapply(x, function(z){
    parts = strsplit(z, " ")[[1]]
    paste0(substr(parts[1], 1, 1), ". ", parts[2])
  }, character(1))
}

# ============================================================
# Standardize plotted tree labels ONCE
# ============================================================
Danaini.tree_plot = Danaini.tree
Danaini.tree_plot$tip.label = abbr_tip(Danaini.tree_plot$tip.label)
tips = Danaini.tree_plot$tip.label

# ============================================================
# Build 1-col "matrix" for gheatmap in tree-tip order
#   - one ATPα state per species
#   - missing tips -> "unknown"
# ============================================================
atpa_map = plant_butterfly_long_all %>%
  transmute(
    tip = abbr_tip(butterfly_species),
    atpa_state = replace_na(atpa_state, "unknown")
  ) %>%
  distinct(tip, .keep_all = TRUE)  # keep first state per tip (assumes unique)

atpa_mat = tibble(
  tip = tips,
  atpa_state = atpa_map$atpa_state[match(tips, atpa_map$tip)] %>% replace_na("unknown")
) %>%
  column_to_rownames("tip")

# keep fill levels stable for legend ordering
atpa_mat$atpa_state = factor(
  atpa_mat$atpa_state,
  levels = c("LAN", "LSN", "VSN", "VSH", "unknown"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# Plot: tree + strip + labels (same as your logic)
# ============================================================
p = ggtree(Danaini.tree_plot, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE, size = 0.3) +
  xlim(0, max(ggtree(Danaini.tree_plot, branch.length="none")$data$x) * 1.45) # this part here also controls distance of phylogenony from heatmap

p_dan_tree = gheatmap(
  p, atpa_mat,
  offset = 0.05, 
  width  = 0.025,
  colnames = FALSE,
  color = NA
) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, offset = 0.75, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = expression("ATP"*alpha*" state"),
    values = c(
      "VSH" = "#ed1c2c",
      "VSN" = "#f36f21",
      "LSN" = "#fec12b",
      "LAN" = "#3a6a9e",
      "unknown" = "grey80"
    ),
    breaks = c("VSH", "VSN", "LSN", "LAN", "unknown"),
    drop = FALSE
  )

p_dan_tree
```

## 4.3 Apocynaceae/Moraceae plant tree

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4) Add Apocynaceae/Moraceae plant tree on top of the geom_tile heatmap
# ============================================================

anno_carden = col_tax2 %>%
  mutate(
    label = as.character(plant_genus),
    cardenolide_state = if_else(known_cardenolide == 1L, "Present", "Absent")
  ) %>%
  select(label, cardenolide_state)

p_apoc_tree = ggtree(Apocynaceae.moraceae.tree, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE, size = 0.3) %<+% anno_carden +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = cardenolide_state), size = 1.5) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, angle = 90, hjust = 1, offset = -3, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Cardenolides",
    values = c("Absent" = "grey80", "Present" = "black")
  ) +
  xlim_tree(1) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  geom_strip('Pachycarpus', 'Melodinus', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Apocynaceae", offset= 23, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) + 
  geom_strip('Trophis', 'Streblus', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Moraceae", offset= 23, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) + 
  geom_strip('Pachycarpus', 'Toxocarpus', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Asclepiadoideae & Secamonoideae (milkweed lineages)", offset= 30, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) + 
  geom_strip('Gymnanthera', 'Hemidesmus', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Periplocoideae", offset= 30, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_strip('Aganosma', 'Strophanthus', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Apocynoideae", offset= 30, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_strip('Carissa', 'Cerbera', fontsize=3, barsize=0.3, color='black', label="Rauvolfioideae", offset= 30, offset.text =3, hjust = 0.5) +
 
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme(
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5, 5, 5.5)
  )

p_apoc_tree
```

## 4.4 Combine plots

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5) Combine plots
# ============================================================

fig_final = plot_spacer() + p_apoc_tree + p_dan_tree + p_tile +
  plot_layout(
    ncol    = 2,
    widths  = c(1, 2),
    heights = c(1, 2.2),
    guides  = "collect" # this is to keep all the legends together
  ) &
  
 theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
  legend.key.width  = unit(0.4, "cm")
)

fig_final

ggsave("./Ext_Fig1_butterfly_x_plant.pdf", fig_final, width = 12, height = 10)
```

The derived VSH genotype originated within the subgenus *Danaus (Danaus)* and is associated with consistent specialization on highly toxic milkweeds (Fig. 2), suggesting an adaptive role in overcoming elevated cardenolide concentrations.
